shortDescription: Manage DNS resolver cache configuration on a BIG-IP

options.name: answer_default_zones
options.description: Specifies whether the system answers DNS queries for the default zones localhost, reverse 127.0.0.1 and ::1, and AS112. When creating a new cache resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(false).

options.name: forward_zones
options.description: Forward zones associated with the cache. To remove all forward zones, specify a value of C(none).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the cache.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: route_domain
options.description: Specifies the route domain the resolver uses for outbound traffic.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.
